8.7.1 Mandatory interfaces
Note: This section defines all interfaces, which are required to fulfill the core function-
ality of the module.

API Function
Header File
Description
Csm_KeyElementGet
Csm.h
Retrieves the key element bytes from a specific key
element of the key identified by the keyId and stores
the key element in the memory location pointed by
the key pointer.
Csm_KeyElementSet
Csm.h
Sets the given key element bytes to the key
identified by keyId.
Csm_KeySetValid
Csm.h
Sets the key state of the key identified by keyId to
valid.
